evals.prompt: Build a landing page for a Kyoto ceramics studio's online shop. Fresh Next.js App Router project with Tailwind v4, no existing design.
evals.expected_output: Context Read with dials, short questions or stated assumptions, a Design Plan, tokens-first page, DESIGN.md, verification report.
expectations: DESIGN.md exists and its on-* pairs pass scripts/contrast.mjs
slop-lint reports 0 errors on the generated app/ and components/ folders
No Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk, Fraunces or Instrument Serif unless justified in DESIGN.md
CSS contains a prefers-reduced-motion rule
Exactly one h1 on the page
Every img or next/image has width and height or fill with sizes
Copy names ceramics, Kyoto or the studio specifically; no lorem ipsum, no invented testimonials

evals.prompt: Redesign this pricing section, it looks generic.
evals.expected_output: Context Read, critique of the template defaults, redesigned component using tokens.
expectations: slop-lint findings on the file drop by at least 80% versus the fixture
Tokens are defined before they are used in the component
The three-identical-cards layout is changed or its choice is justified
CTA labels name the outcome instead of 'Get started' for every tier

evals.expected_output: Before | After | Why table with locations, no code rewrite.
expectations: Output contains a Before | After | Why table
Flags missing labels (placeholder used as label)
Flags blocked paste on the CVC field
Flags the div used as a button
Flags small target size on the coupon link
Flags the vague 'Invalid input' error
Does not rewrite the file unless asked

evals.prompt: In this Angular standalone app, add a dashboard home showing orders, revenue and a recent orders table.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard using Angular conventions and data-dense guidance.
expectations: Uses @defer for below-the-fold widgets
Uses NgOptimizedImage for any images
Numbers use tabular-nums
Table has loading, empty and error states
Context Read states dials near 3/3/7

evals.prompt: Add dark mode to this Tailwind v4 site.
evals.expected_output: Token-level dark theme with verified contrast.
expectations: Dark values defined as token overrides (@theme variables or CSS custom properties), not per-component dark: classes everywhere
Dark surface is not pure #000
color-scheme is set
All dark on-* pairs pass contrast

evals.expected_output: Discovery first, then at most 5 batched questions with defaults.
expectations: Inspects the repo before asking
Asks 5 or fewer questions, each with a proposed default
Does not ask anything answerable from package.json or existing files

evals.prompt: Document our existing design system as DESIGN.md.
evals.expected_output: DESIGN.md matching the fixture values, no visual changes.
expectations: DESIGN.md colors correspond to the fixture values (#fbfaf7, #1f2328, #0f5c4d, #ffffff)
Typography lists Source Serif 4
Notes the radius inconsistency (10px vs 14px) and the near-duplicate gray (#6b7280 vs #6b7281)
existing-styles.css is unchanged
